adminImport.title: Import from the registry
adminImport.intro: Upload units first, then owners. Each file is checked first: the import runs only when it has no errors and every ambiguous match is resolved. Uploading the same file again changes nothing.

units.title: Units
units.hint: units.csv: cadastral_code, kind, number, floor, floor_label, area_m2, tariff_category. Existing units are updated from the file.

owners.title: Owners
owners.hint: owners.csv: cadastral_code, owner_key, owner_kind, registry_name, id_numbers, share, share_note, is_contact. Owners are matched by document numbers, then by name.

adminImport.notReadyErrors: Fix the errors in the file and upload it again.
adminImport.notReadyAmbiguous: Resolve the ambiguous matches and press “Check again”.
adminImport.ambiguousHint: Choose who this is. Left to resolve: {count}.
